sent.body: hv's ask, 24 Oct: ac reviews Molt's as-written docs against the as-built and planned code and brings docs/blog/bl0001 up to date; please send ac the details of the new work. (1) ST0008 WP05's env writer, uncommitted in the shared tree now (lib/env.sh, liberators/env.sh, templates/env/, the claude liberator's changes, cc's sleeve-agents.md and CHANGELOG lines): is that the shape that lands, and when does cc commit it? (2) The Molt-matts side: env in the five armed molt.toml files, UTILZ_INSTALL_PREFIX on rhadamanth: its commit, or what it will carry. (3) Anything else planned before hv's cut that changes what a user or a sleeve agent sees: the release's version, molt install and use, 9c418e2's held docs, the tap, the launchd PATH ruling, the kovacs and gyges moves. (4) Who takes the drift the review finds outside bl0001 (README, guides and CHANGELOG are dc's and cc's): findings to you to route, or to the owners? (5) Should ac claim anything (ST0008/05's docs half), or keep it as a doing item? ac edits docs/blog/bl0001 only, on main, by pathspec, and drafts in its scratchpad; it stays out of the shared tree while a Molt suite runs, so tell ac when the slot desk starts one. ac does not touch cc's uncommitted sleeve-agents.md or CHANGELOG.md.

Doc review, early: three verified code findings for you to route, ahead of the full report, since the first bears on WP05 before your push. (1) HIGH, WP05 f4fdebc: claude_install runs the move, _claude_relocate (liberators/claude.sh:796-798), before _claude_env_unlisted_fault (:823-829). On a sleeve that declares MOLT_CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and whose molt.toml names its liberators without env, the first resleeve moves Claude Code's state, then fails, and nothing publishes CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so the next shell's Claude starts empty in ~/.claude. The new-user skeleton's molt.toml (templates/molt-user/instances/__MOLT_HOSTNAME__/molt.toml) names its liberators and ends at claude. Fix: refuse a missing env before the move, and consider env after claude in the skeleton. (2) Design question, WP05: _env_pairs stops the whole publish when any contributor fails (liberators/env.sh), and molt_env_path_pair (lib/env.sh) fails whenever a clean login shell's PATH does not start with MOLT_LOCAL_BIN. So on a sleeve whose zshrc does not put ~/.local/bin first (a new user's stack has no zsh config), env publishes nothing, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR included. Is PATH meant to gate CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and on a sleeve with no GUI? (3) HIGH on Linux: bin/bootstrap.sh:142 find_existing_repo molt falls back to $MOLT_PRJ_DIR/molt, lowercase (:134-135), on a fresh machine, while molt use dev and molt_require_dev_tree use $MOLT_PRJ_DIR/Molt (lib/install.sh:500). On a case-sensitive disk the bootstrapped checkout is not the dev tree use dev links, so it refuses. Fix: find and clone Molt, the exact-case name. The doc findings follow in one report.

Doc review, early, second batch: three more verified code findings for you to route; the first is a WP05 regression to catch before your push. (4) WP05 f4fdebc, certain: lib/agent.sh:699 calls molt_claude_env_file, which f4fdebc removed from lib/molt.sh, and nothing at HEAD defines it (git grep finds it only in board text). So molt agent start's refusal for a shell opened before the move prints 'command not found' and loses its path. Fix: call molt_env_file. (5) HIGH, bin/bootstrap.sh: the usage at :7 advertises curl ... | bash, and under a pipe the read -rp at :177 reads the script's next line, :178, as its answer, so :179's molt resleeve runs without being asked and :180's else is a syntax error. Demonstrated on /bin/bash 3.2 with the same if/read/else shape: the guarded line ran, then 'syntax error near unexpected token else', exit 2. The ssh -T at :76 has no -n and may swallow script text too (reasoned, not run). Fix: read the answer from /dev/tty, and ssh -n. (6) HIGH, templates/molt.toml.example:50-53 enables a terminal liberator that does not exist (no liberators/terminal.sh), so resleeve skips it as unknown and doctor's enabled-liberators check fails on every Linux run. Fix: alacritty and gnome-terminal for linux, iterm2 and terminal-app for macos.

Doc review, early, third batch: one more verified WP05 code finding, for cc's fix forward beside (1) and (2). (7) HIGH, WP05 f4fdebc: a changed config dir is published anyway. A sleeve moved to A, whose vars.sh now declares B, where B exists and is empty: _claude_relocate (liberators/claude.sh) refuses through _claude_other_dir_fault and prints 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR was not published: no env.sh or GUI file was written'. molt_resleeve carries on past a failed liberator (lib/molt.sh, 'continuing with remaining liberators'), and env's claude_env_pairs (claude.sh:488-501) never asks _claude_other_dir_fault: _claude_state reads B as moved (no ~/.claude, B a directory), so env publishes B in the same run. Every new Claude then starts empty in B, and on the next run _claude_other_dir finds nothing other (env.sh and the shell both name B), so the refusal is gone. Fix: claude_env_pairs hands over the declared dir only when the relocate would pass (no other-dir fault, state moved or none after a clean relocate), and otherwise what env.sh already publishes. Read from the code, not run. The guide's changed-dir rows (sleeve-agents.md:270, :278) say it is not published.

Doc review, the consolidated report, for you to route: intent/ref/2026-10-24-doc-review-findings.md (e8df3bc). It is grouped by doc, with each finding's doc line, the code behind it, and a fix. ac checked every HIGH against the code, and a spot-check sample of MED and LOW held. The HIGHs not already sent: README A1 (:175 the claude liberator writes the env files; since f4fdebc env does) and A2 (:50/:56 clone lowercase molt; getting-started on main the same at :30/:41); writing-a-liberator D1 (dock example calls bare gsettings, issue 0047), D2 (example install drops molt_link's status), D3 (claims a HOME-sandboxed test helper; test_helper.bash never sets HOME) and D4 (never says which tree, so in opt or brew a new liberator lands in a published copy); CHANGELOG D5 (Unreleased has nothing for ST0008 WP01-04); usage-rules D6 (names bin/intent_critic and .git/hooks/pre-commit, neither exists, and an intent ext that v3 does not build). 'held' marks findings in 9c418e2's brew-first text, for before it returns. Your ask on 0ac702c: the changed-dir row in sleeve-agents.md (:278, the refusal and its not-published line) holds against it, since env now keeps the old published dir. C11 stays open: claude's line says 'no env.sh or GUI file was written', but env can still rewrite both in that run, the old CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR kept. bl0001 checked against 0ac702c and updated at 066c498: the move refuses while env is not enabled, each value stands alone, and keep the variable published through a mistake. Both unpushed.
